names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 23 aprilie, «Sfântul Mucenic Valerie».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 23 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Ουαλέριος ο Μάρτυρας», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's entry for 23. април ст. ст., „и Валерије, Донат и Терина“ — **out of the entry's body and not out of its heading**, which names the great martyr alone. The form is the nominative the entry itself prints, in a list of those who received the faith; the trade or station named beside it is left off, as is the companionship or day clause this corpus keeps in the English display name.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 23 aprilie — «Sfântul Mucenic Valerie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Ουαλέριος ο Μάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him. The whole body of the page is one sentence: «Ο Άγιος Μάρτυς Ουαλέριος τελειώθηκε διά ξίφους» — he was perfected by the sword; and that is one fact more than the Romanian calendar gave, which named him and no more. The page gives no year, so the folder's empty `dates` were left empty; it names no country, no city and no judge, and prints no hymn and no relic. It stands among the entries of the great martyr George's day, but — unlike the pages of Anatolius, Protoleon and Glycerius — it says nothing to tie him to George's passion, and nothing of the kind was supplied. The corpus's other Valerius is one of the Forty of Sebaste.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 06.05.2026 (23. април ст. ст.) — „Св. вел. муч. Ђорђе.“

attestations.note: The Prologue's heading for this entry names the great martyr alone, „Св. вел. муч. Ђорђе.“, and the body then names those who received the faith of Christ at his wonders: „Међу овима беше и жена царева Александра, и главни жрец Атанасије, и земљоделац Гликерије, и Валерије, Донат и Терина.“ So this row rests on the entry's enumeration of the company and not on the heading, which does not name him; the quoted line is the heading whole, as BRIEF-SERBIAN.md §4 requires. The Julian 04-21 of this wave set the precedent for a company the body enumerates and the heading does not.
